test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 24 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The deadline for the abolition of the reservation of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes in the year 2020 was extended for further ________ years.
solution:
The correct answer is __**10 years.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The deadline for the **abolition **of the **reservation** of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes was extended by the** Parliament in January 2020** for another **10 years **until **2030.**
 
• This extension was made to ensure that the **benefits of reservation** reach the most marginalized sections of the society who have** historically faced discrimination **and **social exclusion.**
 
• The reservation policy was introduced in India in **1950** as a measure to uplift the **status of the oppressed** and **underprivileged communities **and has been extended several times since then.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1**, i.e., 20 years, is **incorrect** as it would mean that the deadline for abolition would be pushed to 2040, which would defeat the purpose of the reservation policy.
 
• **Option 3,** i.e., 15 years, is also **incorrect** as the extension granted by the Parliament is for 10 years and not 15 years.
 
• **Option 4**, i.e., 5 years, is **incorrect **as it would mean that the deadline for abolition would have been in 2025, which is not the case as the extension has been granted until 2030.
 
• There is **no option **5 mentioned in the question.
